investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Pineora Trips (travel booking); Platform: AWS sa-east-1 (zones sa-east-1a/sa-east-1b/sa-east-1c); network range 10.204.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster pineor-prod-saeast (EKS); Database: mysql server search-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-62e3f92ed484b896a; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
